deviations: The pre-registration names a Wilson interval for end-to-end delivery. Each cell reports delivery_pooled: total delivered over total sent across its seeds, with a Wilson 95 % interval that treats every packet as an independent trial. The rows carry only delivery_ratio, so the counts are rebuilt from the mission's fixed send schedule (one packet at t = 0 and one every 1 / rate_hz s up to the run duration) and accepted only where ratio x sent is a whole number. The order-statistic median interval of the per-seed ratios (delivery_ratio_interval) is also reported, because it does not assume packets are independent within a run and because the Addendum A relay goal rule is written on it.
limits: Simulated only: no drone or radio hardware was used.
Link loss patterns are synthetic (named presets in sim/missions/presets.py), never measured.
Vehicle parameters are literature-derived (point mass, or the crazyflie-class physics profile).
Simulated only: the radio channel and retry behavior are model outputs, not measurements.
Radio geometry is fixed at the commanded hover positions; vehicle motion and antenna attitude are not coupled to path loss.
retries_mean is null because RadioMissionLink does not expose per-packet retry counts in its public event records.
Each hop is its own radio model, so the far drone's and the relay's transmissions never compete for airtime (one shared channel would add contention; at 10 Hz and 32 B that is small, Run C EXP-014).

Latency (median and p95) is computed over delivered packets only, so it is conditional on delivery: at long range it describes the packets that got through, not the lost ones. Each cell reports seeds_without_delivered_packet.
missing_metrics: retries_mean: RadioMissionLink does not expose per-packet retry counts; mission returns null.
physics_geometry_note: Physics rows equal point-mass rows by construction: path loss uses the fixed commanded positions (sim/missions/relay.py limits), so the physics adapter only changes the vehicles, not the radio geometry.
prediction: d_max with 0 dB margin is about 600 to 700 m (Run C: d90 409 m, d10 746 m for the stress corner); direct delivery near 100 % at 300 m, near 0 beyond about 900 m; f = 0.5 keeps delivery above 99 % to about 1100 m; asymmetric relays (0.25, 0.75) fail first on the long hop. Latency roughly doubles with the relay (two hops, plus retries on the weaker hop) but stays under 10 ms median.
